notes.notes: BattleSteam release

notes.title: Game Release | August 1st
notes.notes:
Ladies and gentlemen! We've all been waiting for this for so long, and today you can already plunge into the amazing world of BATTLE STEAM!
The indie game will be released on August 1, 2022.

So be patient, be in a good mood, unpack your devices and get ready for this great event.

We're going to be with you all week long to play ,to hear your feedback, and to answer your questions and comments.

Invite your friends in already our shared discord server (https://discord.gg/ze2EfAJz), because the more people will be there, the juicier the action will be.

In honor of the release we'll hold contests and raffles for those who have been with us for long, and for those who are there just to prove themselves in the upcoming battles. Prizes and gifts from Battle Steam are waiting for you!

Love you all and look forward to seeing you at this grand event!
See you on the 1st of August!

Honor and good luck.

notes.title: In other news!!!
notes.notes:
The game continues to undergo changes and the following updates are on the agenda:📃

⚠1. The HUD in the game has been redesigned. For those who do not know, the HUD is the player interface (health, armor, amount of ammo, etc.). Now the game is more comfortable and easier to play.
⚠2. In the game store appeared skins for blocks, as well as prices, which do not bite.
New effects for blocks, which may be subject to destruction.

We are trying to bring as many innovations and changes to the game to make it as popular as Winchester speed rifles for release.😎

Many thanks to all those who take part in the beta tests and give their feedback regarding the experience. Bow down and hats off to all of you.🥰

And also we remind you that you can get the key from the game on our discord server (https://discord.gg/X64BNDj). You need to go to chat please-give-me-a-key, write "pls key" and you will get our game key🔑

Play good games🤠

notes.title: Most of the characters and the transfer of the game's release
notes.notes: We would like to postpone the release date of the game in order to completely complete the integration with Steam, introduce more features for players, replace most of the content so that it does not look like other games, improve performance and conduct more real integration tests, add more content, for this we it takes more time.

notes.title: New blocks
notes.notes:
Thanks to the new blocks, skirmishes between players will become more tactful. Blocks have a large number of lives and can withstand heavy damage.

Blocks will be available in the next update;)

notes.title: Training mode
notes.notes:
In training mode, you can get acquainted with the basics of construction and the game process, now the training mode is at the development stage, but in the near future there will be ai and the possibility of survival based on the training mode. Workout guide will be available in Steam in the appropriate section. Also in the mode there will be an opportunity to visit buildings not available in the network game mode.
